title: A style's beforeAutospacing/afterAutospacing survives a direct w:spacing literal that carries no autospacing attribute (before=0 or before=400 both render the 14pt auto), an explicit autospacing=0 turns it off, a child style's bare literal keeps it too
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-11-08, compat 15; compat 12 identical), pymupdf baselines, Letter, TNR 12 docDefaults after=0 line=240, style NW before=100 after=100 autospacing on, Normal neighbours; pitches 27.84/27.60 = 13.8 line + 14 auto, 13.92/13.68 = no gap

cases.note: T2 direct before=0 after=0, no attribute
T4 direct before=400 without the attribute: the literal is inert
T6 child style with a bare before=0 after=0
T7 line=480 with a bare literal
the inline margin is the auto value, not the literal 0
